paragraphs.text: Hargilde , Kindly Runechanter , is a legendary human from Innistrad .

Hargilde is a female human runechanter from the Church of Avacyn . Runechanters are a specialized branch of the clergy that specializes in engraving blessings on material objects, including weapons. Everything from swords to axes to children's toys has words written on it in an effort to protect its owner. The best runechanters can write so small that hundreds of these blessings can be squeezed into a small space. She works in a laboratory and uses a flask that produces flame to inscribe runes on weapons like swords. She wears heavy-duty protective clothes and goggles with multiple lenses to assist with her tasks.
